notes.title: Accessing the Main Game when you have the DLC
notes.content: To access the main game again, please go to your library and select the game. Scroll down until you see 'Manage my DLC'. Uncheck the DLC in order to access the main game. Check the DLC again in order to access the DLC. I'll think of more convenient ways in the future, but for now, I hope this will do. Have a good day ^^

notes.title: It's fixed! The DLC is now accessible!
notes.content:
I'm so sorry for the wait. I thought the DLC is working, but apparently, I overlooked an important setting that allows everyone else to access the game. 
If you check 'Manage My DLC, it should be downloaded and installed.
Again, I apologize for the inconvenience. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Fixing the Issue...
notes.content: I've been receiving reports that people couldn't access the game, so I've been trying my best to figure out the issue. For now, I asked steam support for help and hopefully they will get back to me before or after the weekend. For some reason, it worked fine on my computer, so I thought it was ready to be published. That was my fault. I was afraid(?) of asking for help since I didn't want to be a bother, but I realized I have to change this mindset to solve this issue. So I've reached out to my friends to ask for their help and hopefully, the game will be accessible in a few days. Feel free to get a refund since if it's not accessible. I promise this is a real product, I'm just struggling with distributing it. I hope you'll wait a few days for me to fix this issue. Thank you for your patience, and I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: The Sequel is Now Out!
notes.content:
There's a new love interest waiting to be introduced!
Kai's relationship with Percy and Gavin feels shaky after being away from them for three years to study abroad. The two of them are now closer with one another, making Kai feel distant and left out at times. One day, a charismatic man named Lance appears into his life. Oblivious of Lance's feelings toward him, he befriends the man. Everyday, Lance would whisper things into his ear, causing him to doubt his current relationship even more. Is Lance a charming Prince who's meant for Kai, or is he a Villain who wants to ruin a relationship and keep Kai all to himself?

notes.title: Added Original Soundtracks And Polished The Script
notes.content: I finally made original soundtracks for the game.  As for new content, there is none...YET. I'm currently working on a sequel that takes place after the characters become adults.
